description: Issue #148: 'we could not read the violating paths twice' is not evidence that they are the same paths. #201's scope gate fails every turn with an EMPTY logTail — the degraded shape scopeViolationLines is written for — so no turn produces a comparable set and the guard never trips: the worker is driven to the --max-turns 3 cap (3 sends) exactly as before, and the run stops with the ordinary verification failure. A guard that compared empty-to-empty would cut runs short on a CommandMate whose log format merely changed, and its blocking_reasons would name no path for the operator to act on.

201: logTail から違反 path を読み取れませんでした
